_note: Registry of articles that have an image on ImageKit. Key = article id (== the uploaded filename stem), value = the file path within the ImageKit URL endpoint (ik.imagekit.io/civic/<path>). Auto-generated by scripts/sync-imagekit-registry.mjs from the ImageKit Media Library during the build (when IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY is set); this committed copy is the no-key fallback and is kept in sync so local previews match. Only listed articles render an ImageKit image; every other article uses the bundled placeholder.
